body.query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(k IN keys(n) WHERE toString(n[k]) CONTAINS 'GraphiteDeclaredAbsent293746X') RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE any(k IN keys(n) WHERE toString(n[k]) CONTAINS 'GraphiteDeclaredAbsent293746X') RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE n.value CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE n.qualifiedId CONTAINS '938826' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.qualifiedId AS qualifiedId, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n) WHERE any(k IN keys(n) WHERE toString(n[k]) CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET') RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'android.app.Activity' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (c)-[r:DATAFLOW]->(n) WHERE c.value CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET' RETURN id(c) AS source, id(n) AS target, type(r) AS relationship, c.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (c)-[r:DATAFLOW]->(n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'android.app.Activity' RETURN id(c) AS source, id(n) AS target, type(r) AS relationship, c.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE n.value CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE n.qualifiedId CONTAINS '93882699' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.qualifiedId AS qualifiedId, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n) WHERE any(k IN keys(n) WHERE toString(n[k]) CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X') RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (c)-[r:DATAFLOW]->(n) WHERE c.value CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X' RETURN id(c) AS source, id(n) AS target, type(r) AS relationship, c.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (c)-[r:DATAFLOW]->(n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X' RETURN id(c) AS source, id(n) AS target, type(r) AS relationship, c.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 50

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 1

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.apache.tika.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.apache.tika.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 50

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'java.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'java.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) ENDS WITH 'provider'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) ENDS WITH 'provider'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

MATCH (n)
WHERE n.graphId IN ['fixture-android-00', 'fixture-kotlin-compiler-15']
  AND (toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get')
RETURN n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE n.graphId IN ['fixture-android-00', 'fixture-kotlin-compiler-15']
  AND (toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX')
RETURN n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n:FieldNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'FieldNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members
UNION ALL
MATCH (n:ParameterNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'ParameterNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members
UNION ALL
MATCH (n:ReturnNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'ReturnNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members

MATCH (m:Method) RETURN m.graphId AS graphId, m.generic_return_type IS NOT NULL AS returnRendered, m.return_type_info IS NOT NULL AS returnStructured, m.generic_parameter_types IS NOT NULL AS parametersRendered, m.parameter_type_info IS NOT NULL AS parametersStructured, m.type_parameters IS NOT NULL AS formalParameters, count(*) AS members

jvm.scopeEvidence: Each request names all64 real persisted graphs and uses CROSS_GRAPH. The two routing cases actually scan their declared two-graph target; all other cases target64. Legal LIMIT expectations retain complete independently derived row universes, including pre-serialization DISTINCT groups; no sampled response defines an oracle.
